cells: method {sft, opst} x p {0.0, 0.75} x seed {101, 202, 303}; one GitHub Actions dispatch (mode=frozen) of .github/workflows/opst-wr-analogue.yml
primary_metric: mean over the 200 held-out questions of log P(gold letter), renormalised over the four letters, for the evaluated model (OPST: EMA teacher without z; SFT: student)
guards_inconclusive_if_any_fails: base-model held-out metric identical across all 12 cells (determinism)
SFT manipulation bites: mean drop_sft >= 0.02 nats and drop_sft > 0 in >= 2 of 3 seeds
OPST active: mean over seeds of |train-question gold metric after - before| for OPST at p=0.0 >= 0.02 nats
pass: all guards hold, drop_opst < drop_sft in >= 2 of 3 seeds, and mean drop_sft - mean drop_opst > 0
fail: all guards hold and the PASS condition does not
secondary_reported_not_judged: OPST at p=0.75 vs base model (paper: OPST stays above base, SFT falls below)
single_run: The first frozen dispatch is the result of this version. A FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE is reported as such; any change requires a new evaluation id and new held-out questions.
disclosures: Before registration, one calibration dispatch (run 43065140792) scored the base model on the separate 200-question calibration split only: accuracy 0.42, mean gold log-prob -1.2787. It was made with runner sha256 d56701443e144cf04e0a1ba68217a7a0938498022243430c95f24c59ecaa0c9f; the only later runner change replaces the null resolved-revision field with the pinned revision string. The held-out split has not been scored by any model.
Smoke runs used a tiny random-init model on the 8-question smoke split and the first 8 training rows of seed 101.
